items.desc: Keep your coding agent up to date with the latest web best practices
LLM Inference Engine for Metal, CUDA and Vulkan.

Open-source, self-hosted Slack alternative where your team and AI agents work together in channels and DMs. Agents run on Claude, ChatGPT/Codex, Gemini or Grok, with MCP tools, their own computer and browser, routines, memory and approvals. Web, desktop and phone apps. Docker Compose + Postgres. AGPL-3.0.
Six Claude Code skills that make animations for reels, no footage needed: 3D cartoon explainer, stick figure, minimal line art, 3D map route, exploded view, line graph.
Free, open-source embroidery software for Mac and Windows. Turn SVG artwork into machine embroidery, edit stitches visually, and create designs with AI agents via MCP.

Linger is An Open-Source Personal Agent That Runs Fully on Your PC.  We aim to break Big Tech’s grip on AI by bringing powerful local AI to everyday computers through efficient model–harness co-design, so everyone can run their own.
